description: Apply pending Proxmox Virtual Environment SDN configuration cluster-wide. Regenerates /etc/network/interfaces.d/sdn on every node and reloads networking there, so run it in a maintenance window. Use dry_run first to preview the change.

host.description: PVE host name or IP address.

token_id.description: PVE API token ID, for example puppet@pve!puppet-token.

dry_run.description: Preview the change instead of applying it. Returns the interfaces and FRR diffs for the given node without touching anything. Requires node.

node.description: Cluster node to compute the dry-run diff for. Only used with dry_run.

wait.description: Wait for the apply worker task and fail unless it exits OK. Defaults to true.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the apply worker task. Defaults to 300.
